topics.title: How new inventions changed the way we live
guiding_questions: How have inventions changed the way people communicate?
How have inventions made travel and transportation easier?
What do you think about modern inventions?
topics.sample_essay: Modern inventions have changed the way we live in many ways. They have made communication faster and easier through phones and the internet. Travel has become quicker and more comfortable with cars, planes, and trains. Inventions have also improved healthcare with new machines and medicines. I think modern inventions have made our lives more comfortable and convenient.

topics.title: Write about an invention or an inventor
guiding_questions: Who is the inventor or what is the invention you want to write about?
What did he/she invent or what does the invention do?
When and where was it invented?
Why is this invention or inventor important?
topics.sample_essay: Thomas Edison is one of the most famous inventors in history. He invented the light bulb, which changed the world. He lived in the United States in the 19th and early 20th centuries. He also invented many other things like the phonograph and the motion picture camera. Thomas Edison is famous because his inventions helped to bring light and entertainment into people's homes.
